findings.title: Data read + external network = exfiltration path
findings.description: Tools that can read internal data AND make external network requests create a direct exfiltration channel. A hijacked agent could read sensitive data then forward it to an attacker-controlled endpoint. Provided by: snb_get_exchange_rates, snb_get_annual_exchange_rates, snb_get_balance_sheet, snb_convert_currency, snb_get_cube_data, snb_get_cube_metadata, snb_get_balance_of_payments, snb_get_warehouse_data, snb_get_warehouse_metadata, snb_get_banking_balance_sheet, snb_get_banking_income (data_read) + snb_get_cube_data (network_external).
findings.recommendation: Implement tool-level permission scoping. Consider whether both capabilities are necessary or if one can be restricted.

findings.title: Credential access + external network = credential theft path
findings.description: Tools that access credentials AND make external requests can exfiltrate tokens, API keys, and secrets to remote servers. Provided by: snb_get_balance_sheet, snb_get_banking_income (credential_access) + snb_get_cube_data (network_external).
findings.recommendation: Implement tool-level permission scoping. Consider whether both capabilities are necessary or if one can be restricted.

findings.title: Code execution + external network = remote code execution path
findings.description: Tools that execute code AND fetch external content can download and run attacker-controlled payloads. Provided by: snb_get_balance_sheet (code_execute) + snb_get_cube_data (network_external).
findings.recommendation: Implement tool-level permission scoping. Consider whether both capabilities are necessary or if one can be restricted.

findings.title: Broad data read + write = data manipulation risk
findings.description: Tools that can both read and write data could be manipulated to corrupt, overwrite, or delete information. Provided by: snb_get_exchange_rates, snb_get_annual_exchange_rates, snb_get_balance_sheet, snb_convert_currency, snb_get_cube_data, snb_get_cube_metadata, snb_get_balance_of_payments, snb_get_warehouse_data, snb_get_warehouse_metadata, snb_get_banking_balance_sheet, snb_get_banking_income (data_read) + snb_get_exchange_rates, snb_get_annual_exchange_rates, snb_get_balance_sheet, snb_convert_currency, snb_get_cube_data, snb_get_cube_metadata, snb_get_balance_of_payments, snb_get_warehouse_data, snb_get_warehouse_metadata, snb_get_banking_balance_sheet, snb_get_banking_income (data_write).
findings.recommendation: Implement tool-level permission scoping. Consider whether both capabilities are necessary or if one can be restricted.

findings.title: Credential access + data write = privilege persistence
findings.description: Tools that access credentials AND write data could persist stolen credentials or create backdoor accounts. Provided by: snb_get_balance_sheet, snb_get_banking_income (credential_access) + snb_get_exchange_rates, snb_get_annual_exchange_rates, snb_get_balance_sheet, snb_convert_currency, snb_get_cube_data, snb_get_cube_metadata, snb_get_balance_of_payments, snb_get_warehouse_data, snb_get_warehouse_metadata, snb_get_banking_balance_sheet, snb_get_banking_income (data_write).

findings.title: Blast radius: HIGH — compromise of this server has broad impact
findings.description: If this MCP server is compromised, the blast radius is HIGH due to: arbitrary code execution, external network access, credential access, 11 tools (large attack surface). A single tool poisoning or supply chain attack could cascade across all connected systems.
findings.recommendation: Apply least-privilege to this server. Isolate it from other MCP servers. Implement kill switches and behavioral monitoring. Limit env vars to the minimum required.

tools.name: snb_get_exchange_rates
tools.description:
Retrieve monthly CHF exchange rates from the Swiss National Bank (data.snb.ch).

Returns monthly average rates (and optionally month-end rates) for all major
currencies against the Swiss Franc (CHF). Data source: SNB cube 'devkum'.
Rates are expressed as the CHF value of the stated foreign currency unit
(e.g. EUR1: 1 EUR = 0.9416 CHF; JPY100: 100 JPY = 0.58 CHF).

Args:
    params (ExchangeRatesInput):
        - currencies: List of currency IDs (e.g. ['EUR1', 'USD1']). Default: all.
        - from_date: Start month YYYY-MM. Default: 12 months ago.
        - to_date: End month YYYY-MM. Default: current month.
        - include_month_end: Also include month-end rates. Default: False.
        - lang: Response language (de/en/fr). Default: de.

Returns:
    str: Markdown table with dates and CHF exchange rates per currency.
         Includes publication date and data source metadata.

Schema:
    {
      "cube_id": "devkum",
      "publishing_date": "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM",
      "currencies_returned": int,
      "timeseries": [
        {
          "currency": str,
          "type": "Monatsmittel" | "Monatsende",
          "unit": str,
          "values": [{"date": "YYYY-MM", "value": float}]
        }
      ]
    }
tools.poisoning_detail: Tool description is 1226 characters. Long descriptions can hide malicious instructions.

tools.name: snb_get_annual_exchange_rates

Useful for multi-year trend analysis, budget planning, and financial reporting.

        - to_year: End year, e.g. '2025'. Default: current year.
        - lang: Response language. Default: de.

Returns:

tools.name: snb_get_balance_sheet
tools.description:
Retrieve SNB balance sheet (Bilanz) data from the data portal (cube 'snbbipo').

Returns monthly balance sheet positions of the Swiss National Bank in millions
of CHF. Covers assets (gold, foreign exchange reserves, repos) and liabilities
(banknotes in circulation, sight deposits of domestic banks, government deposits).

Key positions:
- GFG: Gold und Forderungen aus Goldgeschäften
- D: Devisenanlagen (foreign exchange reserves — the world's largest relative to GDP)
- N: Notenumlauf (banknotes in circulation)
- GB: Girokonten inländischer Banken (sight deposits)
- T0/T1: Total Aktiven / Total Passiven

Args:
    params (BalanceSheetInput):
        - positions: List of position IDs. Default: key positions (GFG, D, N, GB, T0, T1).
        - from_date: Start month YYYY-MM. Default: 24 months ago.
        - to_date: End month YYYY-MM. Default: latest available.
        - lang: Response language. Default: de.

Returns:
    str: Markdown summary and JSON data in millions CHF.
tools.poisoning_detail: Tool description is 984 characters. Long descriptions can hide malicious instructions.

tools.name: snb_convert_currency
tools.description:
Convert a foreign currency amount to CHF using official SNB exchange rates.

Uses the monthly average rate (Monatsmittel) from the SNB data portal.
Suitable for budget calculations, cost estimations, and financial planning.

Args:
    params (ConvertCurrencyInput):
        - amount: Amount in foreign currency to convert.
        - currency_id: SNB currency ID (e.g. 'EUR1', 'USD1', 'JPY100').
        - reference_month: Month YYYY-MM for the rate. Default: most recent.

Returns:
    str: CHF equivalent, exchange rate used, and reference date.

Example:
    amount=45000, currency_id='USD1' → CHF equivalent of USD 45,000
    amount=100, currency_id='JPY100' → CHF equivalent of JPY 100

tools.name: snb_get_cube_data
tools.description:
Retrieve raw data from any SNB data cube by ID.

Generic tool for accessing SNB cubes beyond the dedicated tools.
Use snb_get_cube_metadata first to understand the cube structure.
Browse https://data.snb.ch to discover cube IDs from the URL pattern:
data.snb.ch/de/topics/{topic}/cube/{cubeId}

Args:
    params (CubeDataInput):
        - cube_id: SNB cube identifier (lowercase), e.g. 'devkum', 'snbbipo'.
        - from_date: Start date (YYYY-MM for monthly, YYYY for annual).
        - to_date: End date.
        - lang: Response language (de/en/fr).

Returns:
    str: Raw timeseries data from the cube as JSON.

resources.name: snb_list_currencies
resources.description:
List all currency IDs available in SNB exchange rate cubes.

Returns the full list of currency identifiers that can be used as filter
values in snb_get_exchange_rates, snb_get_annual_exchange_rates, and
snb_convert_currency.

Note on units: some currencies are quoted per 100 units (e.g. JPY100 = 100 JPY).
The rate value always represents CHF per the stated unit quantity.

Returns:
    str: Markdown table of currency IDs, names, and unit multipliers.

resources.name: snb_list_balance_sheet_positions
resources.description:
List all balance sheet position IDs for the SNB balance sheet cube (snbbipo).

Returns asset (Aktiven) and liability (Passiven) position IDs with German labels.
Use these IDs as filter values in snb_get_balance_sheet.

Returns:
    str: Markdown table of position IDs and labels, grouped by Aktiven/Passiven.

resources.name: snb_list_known_cubes
resources.description:
List all verified SNB data cube IDs with descriptions and available tools.

Returns Phase 1 cubes (dedicated tools) and Phase 2 cubes (accessible via
snb_get_cube_data + snb_get_cube_metadata without any code changes).

Phase 1 cubes: devkum (monthly FX), devkua (annual FX), snbbipo (balance sheet)
Phase 2 cubes: snbgwdzid (Leitzins/SARON daily), zirepo (SARON compound rates),
               zimoma (international money market rates), snboffzisa (central bank
               rates comparison), snbmonagg (M1/M2/M3 aggregates)

Additional cube IDs can be discovered by browsing data.snb.ch and reading the
URL pattern: .../topics/{topic}/cube/{cubeId}

Returns:
    str: Markdown tables of cube IDs grouped by phase, with descriptions,
         tools, frequency, and discovery guidance.

resources.name: snb_list_bank_groups
resources.description:
List all bank group IDs used in SNB Warehouse banking statistics (BSTA).

Returns the 12 bank group identifiers (Bankengruppen) with their German
labels. Use these IDs as filter values for the BANKENGRUPPE dimension
in warehouse cube queries.

Returns:
    str: Markdown table of bank group IDs and labels.

resources.name: snb_list_warehouse_cubes
resources.description:
List available SNB Warehouse cube IDs for banking statistics (BSTA).

Returns an overview of all supported Warehouse cubes grouped by type:
- BSTA Bilanz (BIL): Balance sheet data (monthly and annual)
- BSTA Erfolgsrechnung (EFR): Income statement data (annual)

Includes cube ID schema explanation, dimension info, and usage notes.

Returns:
    str: Markdown overview of warehouse cubes with IDs and dimensions.

server.name: <corpus>/registry/29_malkreide__swiss-snb-mcp
server.instructions: MCP server for the Swiss National Bank (SNB) data portal at data.snb.ch. All monetary data is in CHF. No authentication required.

        - to_date: End date.
        - lang: Response language (de/en/fr).

Returns:
    str: Markdown summary with JSON data.

tools.name: snb_get_warehouse_data
tools.description:
Retrieve raw data from any SNB Warehouse cube by ID.

Generic tool for accessing SNB Warehouse cubes (BSTA banking statistics).
Use snb_get_warehouse_metadata first to understand the cube structure.
Use snb_list_warehouse_cubes to discover available cube IDs.

Args:
    params (WarehouseDataInput):
        - cube_id: SNB Warehouse cube ID (uppercase, dot-separated).
        - from_date: Start date (YYYY for annual, YYYY-MM for monthly).
        - to_date: End date.
        - lang: Response language (de/en/fr).

Returns:
    str: Timeseries data from the warehouse cube as Markdown + JSON.

tools.name: snb_get_warehouse_metadata
tools.description:
Get metadata and dimension structure for any SNB Warehouse cube.

Retrieves the cube's dimension definitions and last update date.
Use this before querying snb_get_warehouse_data to understand
what dimensions and filter values are available.

Args:
    params (WarehouseMetadataInput):
        - cube_id: SNB Warehouse cube ID to inspect.
        - lang: Language for labels (de/en/fr).

Returns:
    str: Cube ID, edition date, dimensions and their items.

tools.name: snb_get_banking_balance_sheet
tools.description:
Retrieve banking balance sheet data from SNB Warehouse (BSTA BIL cubes).

Returns total assets and/or liabilities for selected bank groups from the
Swiss banking statistics. Values are converted to millions of CHF.

Args:
    params (BankingBalanceSheetInput):
        - side: 'assets', 'liabilities', or 'both'.
        - bank_groups: Bank group IDs (default: ['A30'] = all banks).
        - frequency: 'annual' or 'monthly'.
        - currency: Currency filter (default: 'T' = Total).
        - from_date / to_date: Date range.
        - lang: Response language.

Returns:
    str: Markdown summary with values in Millionen CHF, plus JSON data.

tools.name: snb_get_banking_income
tools.description:
Retrieve banking income statement data from SNB Warehouse (BSTA EFR cubes).

Returns key income statement positions (Geschäftsertrag, Geschäftsaufwand,
etc.) for selected bank groups. Values are converted to millions of CHF.

Args:
    params (BankingIncomeInput):
        - bank_groups: Bank group IDs (default: ['A30'] = all banks).
        - from_year / to_year: Year range (YYYY).
        - lang: Response language.

Returns:
    str: Markdown summary with values in Millionen CHF, plus JSON data.

resources.name: snb_list_currencies
resources.description:
List all currency IDs available in SNB exchange rate cubes.

Returns the full list of currency identifiers that can be used as filter
values in snb_get_exchange_rates, snb_get_annual_exchange_rates, and
snb_convert_currency.

Note on units: some currencies are quoted per 100 units (e.g. JPY100 = 100 JPY).
The rate value always represents CHF per the stated unit quantity.

Returns:
    str: Markdown table of currency IDs, names, and unit multipliers.

resources.name: snb_list_balance_sheet_positions
resources.description:
List all balance sheet position IDs for the SNB balance sheet cube (snbbipo).

Returns asset (Aktiven) and liability (Passiven) position IDs with German labels.
Use these IDs as filter values in snb_get_balance_sheet.

Returns:
    str: Markdown table of position IDs and labels, grouped by Aktiven/Passiven.

resources.name: snb_list_known_cubes
resources.description:
List all verified SNB data cube IDs with descriptions and available tools.

Returns Phase 1 cubes (dedicated tools) and Phase 2 cubes (accessible via
snb_get_cube_data + snb_get_cube_metadata without any code changes).

Phase 1 cubes: devkum (monthly FX), devkua (annual FX), snbbipo (balance sheet)
Phase 2 cubes: snbgwdzid (Leitzins/SARON daily), zirepo (SARON compound rates),
               zimoma (international money market rates), snboffzisa (central bank
               rates comparison), snbmonagg (M1/M2/M3 aggregates)

Additional cube IDs can be discovered by browsing data.snb.ch and reading the
URL pattern: .../topics/{topic}/cube/{cubeId}

Returns:
    str: Markdown tables of cube IDs grouped by phase, with descriptions,
         tools, frequency, and discovery guidance.

resources.name: snb_list_bank_groups
resources.description:
List all bank group IDs used in SNB Warehouse banking statistics (BSTA).

Returns the 12 bank group identifiers (Bankengruppen) with their German
labels. Use these IDs as filter values for the BANKENGRUPPE dimension
in warehouse cube queries.

Returns:
    str: Markdown table of bank group IDs and labels.

resources.name: snb_list_warehouse_cubes
resources.description:
List available SNB Warehouse cube IDs for banking statistics (BSTA).

Returns an overview of all supported Warehouse cubes grouped by type:
- BSTA Bilanz (BIL): Balance sheet data (monthly and annual)
- BSTA Erfolgsrechnung (EFR): Income statement data (annual)

Includes cube ID schema explanation, dimension info, and usage notes.

Returns:
    str: Markdown overview of warehouse cubes with IDs and dimensions.

ASI06.name: Memory & Context Poisoning
ASI06.gap_note: Axiom detects static patterns. Full coverage requires runtime memory monitoring.

ASI07.name: Insecure Inter-Agent Communication
ASI07.gap_note: Axiom checks transport security. Full A2A protocol analysis requires runtime interception.

ASI08.name: Cascading Failures
ASI08.gap_note: Axiom estimates blast radius from tool capabilities. Full cascading failure analysis requires runtime topology mapping.

ASI10.name: Rogue Agents
ASI10.gap_note: Axiom detects static rogue indicators. Full rogue agent detection requires runtime behavioral monitoring.

MCP01.name: Token Mismanagement & Secret Exposure
MCP01.reason: Regex-based secret detection in server source and client configs plus env-var exposure checks; no entropy analysis, git-history scan, or token lifetime/passthrough checks.

MCP02.name: Privilege Escalation via Scope Creep
MCP02.reason: Permission over-scope patterns, toxic tool-capability combinations, path-escape checks and env-var over-exposure in configs.

MCP03.name: Tool Poisoning
MCP03.reason: Dedicated detector for hidden instructions in tool metadata, plus runtime rug-pull diffing between source and live tool definitions.

MCP04.name: Software Supply Chain Attacks & Dependency Tampering
MCP04.reason: Dependency CVE lookup, known MCP CVEs, install lifecycle hooks, and unpinned npx/uvx/pip/@latest install sources.

MCP05.name: Command Injection & Execution
MCP05.reason: Regex, AST and Semgrep find exec/shell sinks and a heuristic flags sinks inside tool handlers, but there is no inter-procedural taint tracking from tool input to sink.

MCP06.name: Prompt Injection via Contextual Payloads
MCP06.reason: Injection markers are detected in tool metadata, server instructions, resources, prompts and the strings a tool returns (static), and in instructions/resources/prompts read live; payloads produced by calling a tool at runtime are not inspected.

MCP07.name: Insufficient Authentication & Authorization
MCP07.reason: Flags remote servers with no visible auth and servers bound to all interfaces; does not verify OAuth implementation or per-tool authorization logic.

MCP08.name: Lack of Audit and Telemetry
MCP08.reason: Only a low-confidence heuristic for missing logging in tool-defining files; actual audit trails and telemetry pipelines are not verified.

MCP09.name: Shadow MCP Servers
MCP09.reason: Covered by `axiom discover` allowlist on the local machine; no network-wide or fleet discovery.

MCP10.name: Context Injection & Over-Sharing
MCP10.reason: Hard-coded egress URLs, tools that send to caller-chosen destinations and bulk-exposure heuristics are detected statically and live; what context is actually shared at runtime is not observed.
